adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the handler persists new attendees via `prisma.booking.update({ data: { attendees: { createMany }}})` (around lines 92-106) before calling `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` (around line 165) with no `try/catch` and no DB transaction. If the calendar update throws (expired creds, remote event missing, quota, etc.), the mutation will fail after the DB write, leaving guests stored locally but not synced/invited. A retry with the same emails will typically hit `uniqueGuests.length === 0` and throw `BAD_REQUEST` (`emails_must_be_unique_valid`), preventing the user from reaching a consistent state. This partial-failure ordering is directly verifiable from the diff.
